title: Python Basic Exercise for Beginners: 40 Coding Problems with Solutions

exercises.title: Arithmetic Product and Conditional Logic
exercises.statement: Write a Python function that accepts two integer numbers. If the product of the two numbers is less than or equal to 1000, return their product; otherwise, return their sum.

exercises.title: Cumulative Sum of a Range
exercises.statement: Iterate through the first 10 numbers (0-9). In each iteration, print the current number, the previous number, and their sum.

exercises.title: String Indexing and Even Slicing
exercises.statement: Display only those characters which are present at an even index number in given string.

exercises.title: String Slicing and Substring Removal
exercises.statement: Write a function to remove characters from a string starting from index 0 up to n and return a new string.

exercises.title: Variable Swapping (The In-Place Method)
exercises.statement: Write a program to swap the values of two variables, a and b, without using a third temporary variable.

exercises.title: Calculating Factorial with a Loop
exercises.statement: Write a program that calculates the factorial of a given number (e.g., 5!) using a for loop.

exercises.title: List Manipulation: Add and Remove
exercises.statement: Create a list of 5 fruits. Add a new fruit to the end of the list, then remove the second fruit (at index 1).

exercises.title: String Reversal
exercises.statement: Write a program that takes a string and reverses it (e.g., "Python" becomes "nohtyP").

exercises.title: Vowel Frequency Counter
exercises.statement: Write a program to count the total number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) present in a given sentence.

exercises.title: Finding Extremes (Min/Max) in a List
exercises.statement: Given a list of integers, find and print both the largest and the smallest numbers.

exercises.title: Removing Duplicates from a List
exercises.statement: Write a script that takes a list containing duplicate items and returns a new list with only unique elements.

exercises.title: List Comparison and Boolean Logic
exercises.statement: Write a function to return True if the first and last number of a given list is the same. If the numbers are different, return False.

exercises.title: Filtering Lists with Conditional Logic
exercises.statement: Iterate through a given list of numbers and print only those numbers which are divisible by 5.

exercises.title: Substring Frequency Analysis
exercises.statement: Write a program to find how many times the substring "Emma" appears in a given string.

exercises.title: Nested Loops for Pattern Generation
exercises.statement: Print the following pattern where each row contains a number repeated a specific number of times based on its value.

exercises.title: Numerical Palindrome Check
exercises.statement: Write a program to check if a given number is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).

exercises.title: Merging Lists with Parity Filtering
exercises.statement: Create a new list from two given lists such that the new list contains odd numbers from the first list and even numbers from the second list.

exercises.title: Integer Digit Extraction and Reversal
exercises.statement: Write a program to extract each digit from an integer in the reverse order.

exercises.title: Multi-Tiered Income Tax Calculation
exercises.statement: Calculate income tax for a given income based on these rules: First $10,000: 0% tax; Next $10,000: 10% tax; Remaining income: 20% tax.

exercises.title: Nested Loops for Multiplication Tables
exercises.statement: Print a multiplication table from 1 to 10 in a formatted grid.

exercises.title: Downward Half-Pyramid Pattern
exercises.statement: Print a downward half-pyramid pattern using stars (*).

exercises.title: Custom Exponentiation Function
exercises.statement: Write a function called exponent(base, exp) that returns an integer value of the base raised to the power of the exponent.

exercises.title: Check Palindrome Number
exercises.statement: Write a program to check if a given number is a palindrome. A palindrome number remains the same when its digits are reversed (e.g., 121, 545).

exercises.title: Generate Fibonacci Series
exercises.statement: Write a program to print the first 15 terms of the Fibonacci series. The sequence starts with 0 and 1, and each subsequent number is the sum of the two preceding ones.

exercises.title: Check Leap Year
exercises.statement: Write a program that takes a year as input and determines if it is a leap year. Rules for leap years: a year is a leap year if it's divisible by 4, unless it's also divisible by 100 but not by 400.

exercises.title: Merging Two Dictionaries
exercises.statement: Write a program that takes two separate dictionaries and merges them into one single dictionary.

exercises.title: Finding Common Elements (Intersections)
exercises.statement: Take two lists and find the elements that appear in both. Use Sets to perform the operation.

exercises.title: Odd/Even List Splitter
exercises.statement: Start with a list of 10 numbers. Iterate through them and sort them into two separate lists: one for even numbers and one for odd numbers.

exercises.title: Word Length Analysis
exercises.statement: Create a list of 5 words. Write a loop that iterates through the list and prints each word alongside its character count.

exercises.title: Word Frequency Counter (The Histogram)
exercises.statement: Write a program that counts how many times each word appears in a given paragraph and stores these counts in a dictionary.

exercises.title: Print Alternate Prime Numbers
exercises.statement: Write a program to find all prime numbers up to 20, but only print every second (alternate) prime number found.

exercises.title: Dictionary of Squares (Mapping Logic)
exercises.statement: Create a dictionary where the keys are numbers from 1 to 10 and the values are the squares of those numbers (e.g., 2: 4, 3: 9).

exercises.title: Character Replacer (Data Sanitization)
exercises.statement: Ask the user for a sentence. Replace every empty space in that sentence with an underscore (_) and print the final result.

exercises.title: Print Reverse Number Pattern
exercises.statement: Print a downward number pattern where each row starts with a decreasing value.

exercises.title: Digit Detection in Strings
exercises.statement: Write a program to check if a user-entered string contains any numeric digits. Use a for loop to examine each character.

exercises.title: Capitalize First Letter (Title Case)
exercises.statement: Write a program to capitalize the first letter of each word in a given string without using the built-in .title() method.

exercises.title: Simple Countdown Timer
exercises.statement: Create a countdown timer that starts from a given number and counts down to zero using a while loop.

exercises.title: File Creation and Basic I/O
exercises.statement: Write a program that creates a new text file named notes.txt, writes three separate lines of text to it, and then reads that file back to display the contents in the console.

exercises.title: External File Word Counter
exercises.statement: Write a script that opens an existing .txt file and counts the total number of words it contains.

exercises.title: Introduction to Classes (OOP)
exercises.statement: Create a Car class with attributes for make, model, and year. Include a method called start_engine() that prints a formatted string describing the car starting up.
